comment.body:
Thanks for reporting both the update problem and the Mouse Without Borders shortcut conflict. The report shows PowerToys 0.8, but it does not include the update error, the installation source, or the specific shortcut that conflicts, so we cannot yet tell whether there is a current updater defect or a separate shortcut-request.

Please provide:

1. Attempt to update to the latest stable PowerToys release and reply with the exact error text, or the exact version shown if the update succeeds.
2. Tell us where PowerToys 0.8 was originally installed from (Microsoft Store, GitHub installer, package manager, or another source) and whether it was installed for the current user or all users.
3. If the update fails, include the exact visible error and any relevant non-sensitive installer log details.
4. For Mouse Without Borders, name the current conflicting shortcut, the desired shortcut, your keyboard layout, and any other remapping software in use.

This will distinguish an obsolete-installation or installer-path problem from an active update regression, and determine whether the shortcut concern is a reproducible input conflict or a separate feature request.
